expected.question: An explorer says Cebu City is north of Davao City. Choose the lesson clue that supports the statement, then choose the conclusion it supports.
expected.optionA: Cebu City is north of Davao City on the north-up locator
expected.optionB: Cebu City is south of Davao City on the north-up locator
expected.optionC: Cebu City and Davao City mark the same point
expected.optionD: The two city names prove an exact ancient boat journey
expected.explanation: The Find the dots clue says Cebu City is above Davao City on a north-up map. That supports a north-south relationship. Resource and map-limit clues answer different questions; a modern locator does not prove an ancient voyage.
